description: This file implements a React component for a notes application page, managing state related to notes, user authentication, and UI interactions such as create, read, update, and delete notes. It integrates with various services and components to provide note editing and navigation functionalities.

methods.name: NotesAppPage
methods.description: Main React functional component for the notes page. Manages authentication state, notes selection, creation, editing, deletion, and routing logic.

methods.name: handleSelectNote
methods.description: Fetches and sets a selected note based on the user interaction.

methods.name: handleNewNote
methods.description: Prepares the UI to create a new note.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves a new or updated note by calling the respective service functions.
